title: Discuss a Model-Tuning Project
prompt: Walk me through a model-tuning or fine-tuning project. What was the hardest part, what budget did you have, and which quality-versus-cost tradeoff mattered most? Describe a frustrating failed attempt and what you learned from it.

response.placeholder: State your assumptions, then explain your approach and tradeoffs.
response.reference_answer:
This is a practice answer outline, not a reported interview solution.

Choose a real project, define your ownership and explain the business use case and baseline. State the available data, compute, time and money constraints without inventing precision. Describe the evaluation split and why its metrics represented the intended use.

Walk through one failed hypothesis, the evidence that changed your mind and the next experiment. Explain how you compared quality gains against training and serving costs. Distinguish measured results from estimates and describe remaining limitations. Finish with what you would change with the same budget, rather than presenting every experiment as a success.
